About Tamila Chekku Oil

Bringing Tradition, Purity and Natural Goodness to Every Home.

At Tamila Chekku Oil, we believe that healthy living begins with the quality of food we bring into our homes. For over 13 years, we have been dedicated to producing pure, authentic and traditionally wood-pressed oils that preserve the natural goodness of every ingredient.

Our journey began with a simple belief: every family deserves access to pure and healthy cooking oils. With this vision, we established our own dedicated production unit, combining traditional wood-pressing (Chekku) methods with careful processing and quality practices.

We carefully select quality raw materials and follow traditional extraction methods to retain the natural aroma, flavour and goodness of the ingredients. Our commitment is to deliver oils that reflect purity, freshness and authenticity in every drop.

Over the years, we have earned the trust of customers through consistent quality, responsible production practices and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.

With the required business registrations and food safety compliance, including Udyam, Trademark, Import Export Code (IEC), GST and FSSAI, we continue to uphold our commitment to quality and responsible business practices.

At Tamila Chekku Oil, we don't just produce cooking oils; we carry forward a tradition of natural goodness, bringing the goodness of traditional Chekku oils to modern families.

About the Founder

A Personal Journey Towards Pure and Healthy Living

“

I am Mrs. Mahesh, Founder of Tamila Chekku Oil. Along with my husband, I have been running this business for over 13 years with a simple yet meaningful vision – to make pure, natural and traditionally wood-pressed oils available to every family.

As a mother, I have always been conscious about the quality of ingredients used in my home, especially cooking oil, which is an essential part of our everyday food. I strongly believe that good health begins with the food we eat, and the quality of cooking oil plays an important role in our daily lives.

This belief inspired me to take a step towards producing pure and authentic wood-pressed oils using traditional Chekku methods. I wanted to create oils that I could confidently use for my own family and proudly offer to other families as well.

What started as a personal concern for healthy food gradually grew into Tamila Chekku Oil. With the continuous support of my husband, our dedication to quality and the trust of our customers, we have grown steadily over the years.

Even today, our mission remains the same – to preserve traditional oil-making practices, maintain quality and bring natural goodness to every home.

At Tamila Chekku Oil, we treat every customer like family and strive to deliver the same purity and care that we expect for our own family.

With care and commitment,Mrs. MaheshFounder, Tamila Chekku Oil
